notes: Claude now sets a page's scale itself when it's missing or wrong, and tells you which page, the scale and why (Ctrl+Z undoes it). New For Claude tool (J): pin numbered notes N1, N2… on a drawing for Claude to read and do; Claude marks each done with a reply. When Claude zooms a page, going back to that page later keeps your own view. The box under Take Off Measurements is now one Properties tab in even rows.
